subject: Ad-hoc incentive authorization for LLM platform hire
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Ad-hoc incentive authorization for LLM platform hire

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

We have an inbound offer decision window on Rachel Summers (senior inference engineer, candidate ID RF-987). She has an external counteroffer that materially exceeds our standard band. Recruiter flagged that without an enhanced package she will likely decline. I think this hire is strategic for the LLM serving workstream (low ramp time, domain expertise). Requesting authorization for an ad-hoc onboarding package to close the candidate: 

Proposal (recommended):
- Base: $190,000 (within band)
- One-time sign-on: $40,000 (paid 50% at start, 50% at 12 months)
- Equity: additional 0.15% refresh (RSU grant) added to the 4-year schedule with 25% accelerated vest at 12 months
- Retention clause: clawback if leaves < 12 months (pro-rated)

Rationale: counteroffer at $225k total cash + sign-on + elevated equity from competitor. Market comps attached. Candidate has deep inference optimization experience which reduces our time-to-solution on the runtime project — strong upside for current Q4 deliverables.

Requested action: please confirm approval (or suggest adjustments) so I can ask TA/Recruiting to present the updated offer today. If approved, TA will need HC code + cost center for offer letter and finance sign-off for the sign-on.

Attachments: comp_proposal_Rachel_Summers.pdf; resume_Rachel_Summers.pdf

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Sr. Manager, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ad-hoc incentive authorization for LLM platform hire

Logan —

I support making a competitive package here given the ramp leverage. A couple of asks before final sign-off:
- Can we split the sign-on into 3 installments (start / 6mo / 12mo) to improve retention signal?
- Add a 12-month performance milestone tied to the final tranche of the equity refresh (clear objective).

If Karthik & Finance OK the HC code and cost center, I'm comfortable approving the one-time and equity top-up as proposed (or the installment variant). Please loop in recruiting ops and finance once you have the formal comps.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Talent & Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ad-hoc incentive authorization for LLM platform hire

Thanks Logan — quick operational notes:
1) Please confirm HC record: hiring plan code HC-2026-42 and cost center 4002 (Platform Eng). I tagged this as a strategic hire but we need the formal HC entry before offer generation.
2) Provide the comp band snapshot for the role (attached) so Finance can map accrued and cash impact across FY26/27.
3) If we do installment payments for sign-on, outline the payment triggers (start, 6mo, 12mo) and the clawback language.

I attached a quick comp_band_snapshot.png for reference — it shows median market and the band ceiling. With the proposed one-time and equity refresh, this candidate sits ~10% above band ceiling in total comp (one-time + eqx). Approve conditionally on Finance sign-off.

Karthik
Head of Engineering Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@hireflow.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: recruiting_ops@hireflow.com, Rachel Summers <rachel.summers@example.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ad-hoc incentive authorization for LLM platform hire

Hi team —

Following up on behalf of Rachel: she’s very enthusiastic about Redwood and will sign immediately if we can commit to the sign-on structure + the equity refresh (the accelerated vesting at 12 months is particularly important to her). She asked for confirmation on payment schedule and the clawback period before formally accepting.

Suggested offer language from recruiting ops: include the installment schedule (50%/25%/25% or the 3-way split Marissa suggested), reference the 12-month retention/acceleration clause, and add a single-paragraph explanation of the performance milestone tied to the final tranche. If you approve the 3-split, we can generate the DocuSign today (I’ll need the HC-2026-42 confirmation + cost center).

We’ll pause the competitor deadline by 48 hours if we can provide a written commitment.

Thanks —
Aisha Patel
Senior Recruiter, HireFlow (recruiting partner)
